plugin.plugin_plex.name: Plex
plugin.plugin_plex.description: Plex for Discord: library search, now playing, random picks, recommendations, Overseerr requests, account linking with a role, and new-content notices.
plugin.plugin_plex.node.status.label: Plex status
plugin.plugin_plex.node.status.descripti: Server state, playbacks and your link.
plugin.plugin_plex.node.now_playing.desc: Active playbacks in the shared libraries.
plugin.plugin_plex.node.search.label: Plex search
plugin.plugin_plex.node.search.descripti: Finds a title in the shared libraries.
plugin.plugin_plex.node.random.label: Random pick
plugin.plugin_plex.node.random.descripti: A random title; with a command it answers itself with an "Again" button.
plugin.plugin_plex.node.recommend.label: Recommendation
plugin.plugin_plex.node.recommend.descri: Unwatched title in the member's favourite genre.
plugin.plugin_plex.node.request.label: Overseerr request
plugin.plugin_plex.node.request.descript: Requests a movie or show in Overseerr.
plugin.plugin_plex.node.link.label: Link Plex account
plugin.plugin_plex.node.link.description: Starts the plex.tv login; results = login link.
plugin.plugin_plex.node.unlink_account.d: Removes the link and the linked role.
plugin.plugin_plex.node.libraries.label: Plex libraries
plugin.plugin_plex.setting.libraries_hin: Library IDs, comma separated (see /plex-libraries). Libraries of a second server: 2:ID (third: 3:ID …). Only these are searched and shown.
plugin.plugin_plex.setting.linked_role_h: Given after /plex-link, taken away by /plex-unlink. Must be below the bot's role.
plugin.plugin_plex.setting.announce_play: Posts when a linked member starts watching.
plugin.plugin_plex.setting.overseerr_hin: Needs the secrets OVERSEERR_URL (address incl. /api/v1) and OVERSEERR_KEY (Admin → API / Secrets), shared with this plugin.
plugin.plugin_plex.node.watchlist.label: Plex watchlist
plugin.plugin_plex.node.watchlist_add.de: Adds the first Plex hit for a title to the member's watchlist.
plugin.plugin_plex.node.watchlist_remove: Removes a title from the member's watchlist.
